name: CY-Bench: Global Sub-National Crop Yield Forecasting Benchmark
description: CY-Bench is a comprehensive open-access machine learning benchmark dataset for sub-national crop yield forecasting developed by the AgML initiative of the Agricultural Model Intercomparison and Improvement Project (AgMIP), Wageningen University, and CGIAR. Featuring harmonized multi-year crop yield statistics for maize and wheat across dozens of countries, CY-Bench pairs historical yield observations with spatio-temporal agrometeorological indicators from ERA5, soil properties from SoilGrids, and satellite vegetation indices from Copernicus to enable reproducible model evaluation across continents.
